blurDefault.reportedFailure: Z-level blur appeared disabled even though the Graphics strength slider was non-zero.
blurDefault.rootCause: The overlay required both a hidden archived Boolean and the visible strength slider. The Graphics tab only controlled strength, so the two archived values could disagree.
blurDefault.change: Use blur strength as the only effective on/off setting. The positive 1.0 default enables blur and zero disables it. Keep the legacy Boolean registered, but behaviorally ignored, so old client configs load without an unknown-CVar warning.

focusedPolicyTests.gap: The suite covered pass direction but did not assert effective default enablement.

coverage: Lower, base, and looked-up pass policy remains unchanged

gridVehicleDriverInput.reportedFailure: Pressing WASD while buckled into a grid-vehicle driver seat unbuckled the driver.
gridVehicleDriverInput.rootCause: VehicleSystem installed the standard movement relay for every vehicle. The RMC grid hook removed it after entry, but the operator retained CanMove=true. WASD then moved the buckled driver by 0.025 tiles, violating the seat-offset invariant and triggering automatic unbuckling.
gridVehicleDriverInput.change: Install the standard movement relay only for VehicleMovementKind.Standard. Grid vehicles continue to read the operator InputMover directly and never enter the transient relay state.
